story_title: Belief - Meet Me at the Moon
author: Erica Eyer
video_title: Little Larks 1 - Belief - Meet Me at the Moon
description:
After watching the story with your child, consider the following questions for comprehension and discussion:
- Which character in this story is most like you?
- What could Little One depend on?
- How did he remember what was true when things got hard?

Try embodying this story with a yoga story flow by our Well-Being Director, Erica Eyer.
